events.text: Rhyolites from site VBB (St G-le-G) and sites HF 111 and HFV (Le Tour de Kerroc'h) contain magnetite (in a similar size distribution as that of site HFR) with the coarse magnetite, biotite and amphibole phenocrysts being more oxidized (magnetite: c.
Electron microprobe analysis of one of these samples, RB03B, reveals very small (2-3 #m) chromiferous magnetite grains in a chlorite (biotite) host, with larger (10 #m) grains of ruffle.
